sentences.text: The Crime and Misconduct Commission held an inquiry following a referral about media concerns over encrypted police radio communications.

sentences.text: The Commission examined how to balance media scrutiny and reporting with police safety, personal privacy and confidentiality.

cites.document: Striking a balance: An inquiry into media access to police radio communications (9 December 2004)

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that media access to police communications should protect operational safety and individual privacy.

cites.document: Striking a balance: An inquiry into media access to police radio communications (9 December 2004)

sentences.text: The Commission recommended a secure feed from police dispatch records for authorised media outlets, with exclusions and delays for specified incidents.

cites.document: Striking a balance: An inquiry into media access to police radio communications (9 December 2004)

sentences.text: Its 14 recommendations also covered privacy safeguards, staffing, costs and continuing consultation between police and the media.
